import { html } from 'common-tags'

export const registryItem = {
  type: 'registry:ui',
  name: 'calendar',
  title: 'Calendar',

  description: html`
    A date field component that allows users to enter and edit date.

    References:
    - Headless API: https://ark-ui.com/docs/components/date-picker
    - shadcn/ui: https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/calendar
  `,

  dependencies: [
    '@ark-ui/vue',
    '@vueuse/core',
    'lucide-vue-next',
  ],
}

export default registryItem

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { DateValue } from '@internationalized/date'

import { CalendarDate, fromDate, getLocalTimeZone } from '@internationalized/date'
import { ref } from 'vue'

import { Calendar } from '@/components/ui/calendar'

const date = ref<DateValue[]>([fromDate(new Date(), getLocalTimeZone())])
</script>

<template>
  <Calendar.Root
    v-model="date"
    class="rounded-md border shadow-sm"
    :min-value="new CalendarDate(1925, 1, 1)"
    :max-value="new CalendarDate(2035, 1, 1)"
  />
</template>
